summary: The BC Talent program in EMEA, launched three years ago, has onboarded over 700 new Business Central professionals with a 91% retention rate and billable staff in 10 weeks. The video also sets out a strategy for building AI skills in BC teams.
overview:
The video is a two-minute pitch from the Business Central team on the BC Talent program. The program started three years ago to respond to talent challenges and to build the next generation of Business Central professionals. It reports more than 700 new professionals onboarded, a 91% retention rate, and billable readiness in 10 weeks. It also says senior staff can save up to 80% of their time when they do not have to train juniors.

The second part covers AI. It says AI will not replace people, and that building autonomous AI agents needs people who understand industry and business processes and also have AI fluency. It points to upskilling existing teams and recruiting Gen Z talent, and ends with a call to hire people the program has turned into Business Central experts.
key_points: BC Talent started three years ago to address the Business Central talent shortage.
Reported results: over 700 new professionals onboarded and a 91% retention rate.
New professionals are billable in 10 weeks.
Senior staff can save up to 80% of their time by not having to train juniors.
Autonomous AI agents need people who combine industry and business process knowledge with AI fluency.
The AI strategy covers upskilling existing teams and recruiting Gen Z talent with native AI knowledge.
The video ends with a call to hire professionals the program has turned into Business Central experts.
